findings.scenario: A reviewer saves a changed owner, status, or note and then changes a visible priority or status filter before reloading the workspace.
findings.impact: The filter effect deletes the workflow cache, while saveAction never refreshes it, so legitimate saved work disappears on the next load.
findings.evidence: The protected component reproduction observes cache deletion on mount and filter changes; the service reproduction observes the saved draft missing from the next fetch.
findings.fix: Remove cache deletion from filtering and persist an updated copied item list when saveAction succeeds.

findings.scenario: Browser storage contains malformed JSON or a valid JSON object instead of the WorkItem array required by the application.
findings.impact: Parsing rejects or returns the wrong runtime shape, preventing the workspace from reaching a usable loaded state.
findings.evidence: Focused tests reproduce both the thrown parse and non-array result; a type assertion provides no runtime validation.
findings.fix: Parse defensively, accept only arrays, remove invalid cache data, and fall back to source items.

findings.scenario: The default fetch path sorts results when no cached workflow state exists and another consumer later reads the imported fixture.
findings.impact: Array.sort mutates the shared fixture, so later sessions and consumers observe reordered source data.
findings.evidence: The regression reverses the fixture, fetches defaults, and proves the vulnerable implementation changes the fixture order in place.
findings.fix: Sort a shallow copy of the imported fixture and return that ordered copy.

findings.scenario: A reviewer collects evidence while browser storage contains workflow edits that differ from the source fixture.
findings.impact: A read-only operation overwrites saved workflow state with stale fixture values and silently loses user changes.
findings.evidence: The focused reproduction places a sentinel cache value, calls collectEvidence, and observes the vulnerable code replace it.
findings.fix: Remove the storage write so evidence collection only returns evidence.

findings.anchor: export async function saveAction(itemId: string, draft: ActionDraft): Promise<WorkItem> {
findings.scenario: The seeded claim alleges that calling saveAction permanently mutates the imported workItems fixture.
findings.impact: Accepting the unsupported claim would direct remediation at the wrong boundary and obscure the real persistence defect.
findings.evidence: Inspection and reproduction show saveAction returns a newly spread object and performs no assignment, splice, or property write against workItems.
findings.dismissalProof: The inspected saveAction path finds an item and returns a new object; fixture values remain byte-for-byte unchanged after a save reproduction.
